name: Oakville
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: Oakville is known for Bordeaux varieties, with rich texture, firm tannin and notes of mint and herbs.
Its Merlot tends to show ripe blackberry and black raspberry.

blurb.text: A moderately warm AVA in the heart of Napa Valley, between the Vaca and Mayacamas Mountains, with gravelly alluvial loams on its western side and heavier volcanic soils to the east. Its main grapes are Cabernet Sauvignon, Sauvignon Blanc, Merlot and Cabernet Franc, which give ripe, powerful wines.
